description: This file defines the declaration for the `cli_socket` class, which inherits from `socket_thread` and `cli`. It includes method declarations for socket connection management, command handling, and various control functions related to a command-line interface (CLI) socket within the beerocks namespace, used for communication in the prplMesh project.
